notes:
Quick CRM notes / call snippets:
- Use-case: product discovery widget + in-app docs search. Two-stage retriever + learned reranker. Currently doing offline combing of signals (ctr, recency, business rules).
- Wants: a rerank endpoint that supports batch/offline scoring (nightly re-rank of 20M candidates), plus low-latency per-request rerank for interactive queries.
- Metrics they care about: NDCG@10, MAP, top-1 precision, and downstream CTR lift. Team will compute A/B delta on CTR using Redwood outputs.
- Latency targets: for interactive rerank p95 <= 120ms; background batch scoring can be slower but must scale to ~20M items per night. Throughput expectation for dedicated: sustained 2000 rps candidate scoring across pool.
- Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to pay for predictability (reserved) but wants clear per-token vs per-batch pricing. Asked for example math for 10M query-month.
- Security: "we cannot have dev data leave NA region" — legal requires data residency & SOC2 plus KMS integration. SSO via SAML mandatory. Audit logs required for all inference requests.
- POC scope agreed: Hosted API first (2 weeks) to validate relevance gains and basic perf, then proposal for Dedicated reserve for peak season. Team wants canary rollout + automatic fallback to smaller models.
- Rerank specifics: prefer Redwood to expose a top-k rescoring API that accepts candidate context + features; also want offline scoring API for vector+feature batch inputs. SE asked about model version pinning and reroll/rollback behavior.
- Quotes: "If we can move the NDCG needle by 5% and keep p95 under 120ms, we're budgeted for dedicated" — Head of Product.
- Open items: sample eval set quality (gold labels need cleaning), formal security questionnaire (sent 2026-02-02), exact SLO numbers for dedicated (SRE to propose), estimate for nightly 20M batch cost.
- Links: pricing deck (drive), security FAQ (drive), evalset CSV stub (drive); Fireflies for demo call.
- Internal owner notes: prioritize delivering offline scoring harness + example billing calc before next exec touchpoint.
